decision: From Week 8 the weekly quiz and the weekly assignment are replaced by one assignment pack and one quiz sitting after every three classes. Weeks 1 to 6 stay weekly. The forms, the graders and every graded function are unchanged; only the deadlines, the sittings and the way the marks are combined change.

blocks.label: Block 1
blocks.topics: regression, baseline and errors; classification and cost; validation and leakage
blocks.quiz_sitting: In the last twenty minutes of the Week 10 class the lecturer opens the three quiz forms together; each stays open for 24 hours.

blocks.label: Block 2
blocks.topics: features and ablation; choosing a model; regularisation, nearest neighbours and reproducibility
blocks.quiz_sitting: In the last twenty minutes of the Week 13 class the lecturer opens the three quiz forms together; each stays open for 24 hours.
blocks.note: Week 13 has no graded notebook. Its content is assessed in the Block 2 quiz and in the Engineering ML Project milestone.

coursework_rule.weekly: Weeks 1 to 5 stay weekly. Week 6 is waived for all three cohorts. The best 3 of the 5 weekly quizzes (each out of 5) and the best 3 of the 5 weekly assignments (each out of 20) count.
coursework_rule.blocks: Each block is never dropped. Its marks are the sum of its parts: quiz = three forms out of 5 = 15 marks; Block 1 assignment = A7 + A8 + A9 = 60 marks; Block 2 assignment = A10 + A11 = 40 marks. A part that is not submitted scores zero.
coursework_rule.quizzes_out_of: 3 x 5 + 15 + 15 = 45 marks; the percentage is marks earned divided by 45, times 10.
coursework_rule.assignments_out_of: 3 x 20 + 60 + 40 = 160 marks; the percentage is marks earned divided by 160, times 10.
coursework_rule.why: A block carries its weeks. Block 1 and Block 2 hold 6 of the 12 taught weeks and about 60 percent of the coursework marks, and a student cannot drop one.

unchanged: Engineering ML Project (four milestones in Weeks 10 to 13)
forms_in_use: Block 1 submissions use the existing A7, A8 and A9 forms. Block 2 submissions use the existing A10 and A11 forms. Block quizzes use the existing weekly quiz forms opened together.
